about_the_game:
MAN New Lion’s City 12C, 18C & 19C – The New Generation of Urban Transport

Experience urban public transport at the cutting edge of technology – with the complete MAN New Lion’s City family, now available in the 12C, 18C and 19C variants. Six modern city buses – from the compact solo bus to the long articulated bus – give you maximum flexibility for any route, whether in narrow city streets or heavily trafficked main corridors.

Three Variants, Many Possibilities

  • MAN New Lion’s City 12C – 12 meter solo bus with high maneuverability, available with 2 or 3 doors

  • MAN New Lion’s City 18C – 18 meter articulated bus for maximum capacity, available with 3 or 4 doors

  • MAN New Lion’s City 19C – 18.7 meter articulated bus, the longest variant of the family, available with 3 or 4 doors

All vehicles have been produced in series since 2019 and have set standards in modern urban transport – both functionally and visually.

Realism at the Highest Level

These buses have been digitally recreated with the highest standards of detail and authenticity:

  • Highly accurate 3D model based on original manufacturer data

  • Highly detailed cockpit with functional elements

  • Original sound recordings for engines, doors, fans and interior

  • Vehicle physics with realistic inertia, steering and acceleration

  • Extensive interior details including seat textures, displays and ambient lighting

Fully Licensed – Straight from Reality

The MAN New Lion’s City buses were faithfully implemented based on official data and detailed research in close collaboration with MAN Truck & Bus, Dr. Richard and the Eastern Regional Transport Association (VOR).

Official liveries, authentic destination displays and realistic functions ensure that every ride feels like a real operation in modern urban transport – from the detailed 3D model to full integration into gameplay.

Gameplay Features

  • Solo and articulated buses playable – each with different door configurations

  • Dynamic articulated physics for 18C and 19C with realistic pivoting

  • Fully interactive door, lighting, and assistance systems

  • Start/Stop automation, light automation and RGB ambient lighting

Technical Data

MAN New Lion’s City 12C

  • Year: from 2019

  • Length: 12 m | Width: 2.55 m

  • Door variants: 2 or 3 doors

  • Engine: MAN D1556 LOH (Diesel), 243 kW / 330 HP

  • Transmission: ZF Ecolife 6-speed automatic

  • Top speed: 80 km/h

MAN New Lion’s City 18C

  • Year: from 2019

  • Length: 18 m | Width: 2.55 m

  • Door variants: 3 or 4 doors

  • Engine: MAN D1556 LOH (Diesel), 265 kW / 360 HP

  • Transmission: ZF Ecolife 6-speed automatic

  • Top speed: 80 km/h

MAN New Lion’s City 19C

  • Year: from 2019

  • Length: 18.7 m | Width: 2.55 m

  • Door variants: 3 or 4 doors

  • Engine: MAN D1556 LOH (Diesel), 265 kW / 360 HP

  • Transmission: ZF Ecolife 6-speed automatic

  • Top speed: 80 km/h

Whether it’s the compact 12C solo bus, the flexible 18C articulated bus, or the powerful 19C – the MAN New Lion’s City family with a total of six buses elevates quality, realism and driving fun in your virtual fleet to a new level – for bus simulation fans, it’s a dream come true.
